# Tracker finalization and cycle behavior

Build `main.spl` with the candidate source roots and admitted pure-Simple
producer. Execute the linked artifact: require exit 0 and exactly the marker
`tracker-finalize-snapshot: pass`. This is authored, not executed evidence.

The fixture exercises pending source eligibility, a hard cycle, a soft cycle
and its real severity field, a DAG, a prospective cycle, missing adjacency,
repeat finalization and snapshot isolation of row objects and nested build
arrays. Exit codes identify the failed assertion. Neither absence of a compiler
error nor creation of an object alone passes these behavioral assertions.

Keep producer/source/SCV/cache/target/runtime receipts for the coordinated C36
